Interface WeatherStationCI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.ComponentInterface, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.OfferedCI, java.rmi.Remote, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.RequiredCI, WeatherStationConfigurationI

    public interface WeatherStationCI
extends fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.OfferedCI, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.RequiredCI, WeatherStationConfigurationI
    The component interface WeatherStationCI declares the signatures of services offered by a weather station component.

    Description

    This component interface proposes as services the same signatures as in the implementation interface WeatherStationImplementationI.

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant
